# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4999%2E898137%2ETpRoQ8)
**Over**** _$16 million_****has already been spent to boost one of our opponents in this race.**
That’s $16 million coming from corporate PACs, Big Oil, Pharma, AIPAC, and the DC establishment, who’ve decided they want to try to put their thumb on the scale before Michiganders even get to vote.
But here is what they don't want you to see: while corporate and MAGA-funded PACs bail her out with millions in TV ads, our opponent has barely shown up. She has no field program, no grassroots energy, and she isn’t even doing public events to talk to actual voters.
If you’re wondering why so much outside money is being spent this early, you have to ask yourself why. How strong is your candidate if they need to be bailed out instead of earning the win? How is that going to be the strongest candidate to take on well-funded Republican Mike Rogers in November? They want everyone to believe that this race is already decided.
But they don’t decide. You do.
**Here’s what that $16 million doesn’t buy:** → Mallory’s record of delivering for Michiganders. → The fact that Mallory is the candidate best positioned to beat Rogers in November. → The fact that we have the biggest grassroots campaign in this race.
---
Michigan deserves a Senator who answers to Michiganders, not party leaders, not corporate PACs, and not the political establishment.
Mallory doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs or AIPAC money. But with ballots dropping in days and our end-of-quarter deadline looming, we need your support.

Our top-secret strategy
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260616-2922)
Peter,
Fran’s campaign has momentum because people across Wisconsin are ready for something different.
They’re ready for a governor who will take on the billionaires, Big Tech monopolies, insurance companies, corporate landlords, and political insiders who have made life harder for working families.
They’re ready for Fran. And this weekend, we’re going to prove it.
We’re launching a huge [Weekend of Action](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=1&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP) with canvasses across the state — from Madison to Milwaukee, Janesville to Oshkosh, Appleton to Viroqua, Sheboygan to Wisconsin Rapids, and more.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=2&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)
Fran doesn’t have corporate PAC money. She doesn’t have a network of billionaires waiting to write checks. She has us.
And that’s more powerful — if we show up.
[**Will you sign up for a canvass this weekend and help us reach the voters who will decide this race?**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=3&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)
Every conversation matters. Every door matters. Every vote matters.
And if you can’t canvass this weekend, you can still help make this Weekend of Action a success.
[**Chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can to support our volunteers in the field.** ](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=4&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)
Support like yours helps us print literature, send texts, fuel our organizing program, and make sure volunteers have what they need to reach more voters across Wisconsin.
We know the path to victory: Organize everywhere, talk to everyone, and build a movement big enough to win. This weekend is how we do it.
[**Sign up for a Weekend of Action canvass near you today**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=5&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)**—[or chip in $5 to help power the volunteers who are knocking doors for Fran.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=6&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)**
Thank you for being part of this movement.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=9&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)**
Let’s go!!
Team Hong

| | | | | | Team Mackenzie,
Just before the Primary Election, Bob Brooks stood up and apologized for supporting law enforcement. That’s right, Brooks’ extreme leftist base made him apologize for once saying positive things about police!
Now Brooks has done something that he actually should apologize for...but probably won’t because he knows it will make his political bosses angry.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/8pDPLLT9aFm?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)
| | According to yesterday's story from the _Free Beacon_ ,**Brooks recently took to Facebook and lashed out at volunteer firefighters, referring to those who respond alongside paid firefighters as "scabs" and calling them “s##tbags.”**
---
| [Read The Article Here](https://us.list-manage.com/7bF7mGT8wxm?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/dHtKih6BYPb?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)
| | Volunteer firefighters are the backbone of many communities throughout the Greater Lehigh Valley. They leave their jobs, their families, and their daily lives behind when the call comes in. They don't do it for recognition. They do it because they care about their neighbors and want to serve their communities.That's why Brooks’ comments are so disgusting...especially for someone who uses his own background in firefighting as a centerpiece of his campaign.Whether you are volunteer or paid firefighter; I want to personally thank you for everything you do. You are the men and women who run toward danger when everyone else is running away. You deserve our gratitude and respect, not criticism.**While Bob Brooks is attacking volunteer firefighters, I've spent my time in Congress working to support first responders and deliver real results for our communities.****That includes securing more than $5 million in funding for first responder projects across PA-7, including:****• Alburtis Fire Station Upgrade
• Carbon County Sheriff's Office Equipment and Technology Upgrade
• Bethlehem Police Department Equipment and Technology Upgrade
• Eastern Pennsylvania Regional Communications Upgrades
• Palmer Township Radio Upgrades
• Northampton Borough Police Department Radio Upgrades**I've also supported legislation to strengthen public safety, support law enforcement officers, honor fallen heroes, improve officer wellness, and ensure first responders have the tools and resources they need to do their jobs safely.**The difference is simple: I believe first responders deserve our support and appreciation no matter how they choose to serve - Bob Brooks does not.** To every first responder in the Greater Lehigh Valley, thank you for your service. Our campaign appreciates you, supports you, and will continue fighting for you every day.Sincerely, Ryan Mackenzie
Congressman PA-7

Darren is a third-generation family farmer from rural Southern Illinois who, along with his sons, owns and operates Bailey Family Farm where they grow corn, wheat, and soybeans.

Darren married his high school sweetheart Cindy, and they have lived by the motto faith, family, and farming for more than 39 years. Darren began his chapter of public service on the North Clay Board of Education, where he served on the board for 17, including 12 as President.

In 2018, Darren was called to serve in government and was elected to the Illinois House of Representatives 109th district. There he fought for our freedoms and against tax hikes, reckless spending, and sanctuary state legislation. Darren then served the 55th district in the Illinois State Senate, and with his lifelong background in farming, worked as the lead Republican on the Senate Agriculture Committee.

Darren and Cindy live on their family farm near Louisville, where they enjoy time with their loving family.

A poll just leaked. [It's the first real look at the New Mexico Governor's race since the primary](https://us.list-manage.com/8jUDsrkywha?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) — and the numbers behind the headline tell a story the press isn't going to tell you.
Deb Haaland leads Gregg Hull. That's the topline. Underneath it, there's a clean hit Hull has on her that nobody is talking about.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TeJws0kTlEr?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **LEAKED POLL — HAALAND UP 6, BUT THE CRACKS ARE REAL**
The poll went into the field June 9-11 from one of the best firms in the country, and we got a look at every question and every answer in it.
The topline shows Haaland up 6, but the breakdown is where it gets interesting. She's running a 14-point net gender gap with men, and 72% of voters say Haaland is liberal even though only 32% of them describe themselves that way.
The fracking ban is where Hull has his cleanest shot. Even with soft polling language, 44% of voters said it would make them less likely to support her. The real question now is whether Hull is willing to actually throw the punch.

🚨 **$113 MILLION TAX HIKE — THE ONE COUNCIL JUST KILLED IS BACK**
City Council voted 8-1 to reject this in March. Albuquerque Councilor Brook Bassan brought it back anyway — and this time, it's headed to the November ballot.
Half a penny on every dollar. $113 million a year. Funding a project that another councilor — Tammy Fiebelkorn — called a "vanity project."
We pulled the spending data. Albuquerque city spending is up 68% in 10 years.
---
| [Stream No Doubt About It Podcast Now](https://us.list-manage.com/C4PkoRgYxIt?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
💰 **NM RANKS 4TH IN TAXES — AND 50TH IN INCOME**
That's not a typo. We rank fourth in the country for total tax burden. We rank dead last for median household income — $25,000 below the U.S. average.
And the city wants to raise the tax again. We do the math.

😂 **ELON MUSK BECOMES FIRST TRILLIONAIRE — CNN IMPLODES**
The SpaceX IPO Friday was the largest in history. $75 billion raised. Musk briefly worth more than $1 trillion on paper. 4,400 SpaceX employees became millionaires overnight.
Bakari Sellers went on CNN and said no one should be "allowed" to have that much money. Scott Jennings's response is one of his best of the year.

name: Senate Majority Update
subject: Re: Georgia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The path to a Democratic Senate majority runs through Georgia and New Hampshire.
Republicans now have their official Senate nominee in Georgia: **Mike Collins**.
The stage is set for one of the most closely watched races in the country.
But one thing is becoming increasingly clear: Georgia and New Hampshire are the two most important Senate battlegrounds in the country.
**[DONATE TO JON OSSOFF
AND CHRIS PAPPAS ››](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_3.VuPY49&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-3&t=1&akid=7222%2E582294%2EFDosVP)**
Here's what's at stake:
– Georgia is one of Republicans' top targets as they work to defeat Jon Ossoff and reclaim a Senate seat Democrats won just a few years ago.
– New Hampshire is one of the GOP's best pickup opportunities, where Chris Pappas is running to keep this critical seat blue.
– Both races are expected to attract tens of millions of dollars in outside spending because the fight for Senate control could come down to just a handful of states.
**National Republicans understand what's on the line in November.**
That's why they're already spending heavily in Georgia and New Hampshire – with plans to pour millions more into each state by Election Day. They know that winning either race would bring them one step closer to controlling the Senate.
**[Split a donation between
Jon Ossoff and Chris Pappas ›› ](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_3.VuPY49&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-3&t=2&akid=7222%2E582294%2EFDosVP)**
**The path to a Democratic Senate majority runs through Georgia and New Hampshire.**
If we're going to protect these seats, it'll take grassroots supporters stepping up early to help our campaigns build the resources needed to compete.
**[Split $5 – or whatever you can afford today – between Jon Ossoff and Chris Pappas to help defend two of the most important Senate seats in the country.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_3.VuPY49&refcode=em20260616-3&t=3&akid=7222%2E582294%2EFDosVP)**

Team Pappas

body:
We can replace a corporate-backed, Do-Nothing Democrat with a real progressive fighter for working people.
#
Peter,
The Colorado Democratic primary is only two weeks away, **which means we have just 14 days left to elect Justice Democrat Melat Kiros in CO-01!**
She’s taking on 15-term incumbent Rep. Diana DeGette, a longtime Washington establishment politician backed by corporate-aligned interests like Big Pharma and AIPAC.
Melat’s running because she knows we can’t solve our biggest problems with politicians who answer to the same corporations and billionaires keeping prices high, fueling climate crises, and profiting from endless wars and genocide.
**Instead, she’s fighting for Medicare for All, housing as a human right, universal childcare, ending forever wars, and a government that actually puts working people over profits.**
In a recent debate, she called out her opponent without hesitation: when DeGette claimed she didn’t know why Congress hasn’t passed Medicare for All, Melat pointed to the real obstacle — _politicians like DeGette who continue to cash checks from Big Pharma while families struggle to afford care._
_That’s why this race matters, Peter._
Transforming the Democratic Party doesn’t happen by asking the same do-nothing, entrenched politicians to do better. It happens by taking them on, voting them out, and replacing them with leaders who are ready to fight for working families.
**Melat is running to do exactly that — and we need your help to make sure we can get her across the finish line in two weeks.**
Like every Justice Democrat, Melat refuses corporate PAC money and is running a grassroots campaign completely fueled by people power.
**[With just 14 days left, we need the resources to reach every voter and turn our momentum into victory. Can you rush $10 or whatever you can to Justice Democrats and Melat Kiros before the June 30th primary?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260616-mk.a8ecro&refcode=em20260616-37916&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=37916%2E1203867%2EybvgMD)**

In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

body:

| | | | | | Hi Peter,
On Sunday, I laid out my vision for how I believe the Wisconsin State Treasurer can be a force for good. Watch my speech below!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/D8Z__y3UtkY?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
|
---
| |
_**Wisconsin’s problem is not that we are too divided. It’s that our systems are not built for us.** They are built for consultants and special interests who use confusion and division to get their way._
_That’s why I have a plan for the State Treasurer’s office to use**Public Power for the Public Good.**__**I will bring Government Transparency into the 21st-Century.** I have a degree in economics and a Master's in Public Affairs _– _but when I got elected to the school board,**I** found our budgets confusing! As State Treasurer, I will make publicly available information **publicly understandable** with a visual, public budget dashboard showing exactly how money flows from our State into your community.__**I will continue to defend Public Education.** I have the experience to protect our**** $1.6 billion Common School Trust Fund from political interference so it always delivers stable funding for our classrooms.__**And** **I’ll** **work across the state** , hand in hand with local organizers, to get basic transparency onto every property tax bill in Wisconsin. **You** deserve to see exactly how much of your hard-earned money is being stripped away from public schools and funneled into an unaccountable, private voucher system!__**Because if you don’t know, you deserve to know, Wisconsin!**_
---
|
---
| |
I believe every single office needs to be a lever of progress in this time of crisis – not just the Governor and our legislators, but the State Treasurer and every constitutional office. We have **seven weeks** until the primary election on August 11th, and at the end of this month, we have our largest fundraising deadline yet.
[June 30th will be a crucial deadline for our campaign, determining how many resources we have for the final stretch, and we need your help. If you’re able, please donate $15, $25 (or if you’re able!) more to help power us through this final stretch.](https://us.list-manage.com/DackF3KzP69?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
We’d love it if you follow along with the campaign on socials too - [Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/_jXnl3o4U_a?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09), [Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/19Go6pY7XUe?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09), [TikTok](https://us.list-manage.com/azbBHm3UebD?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09).
Thank you for being with us in this fight to use _**Public Power for the Public Good**_ ,Dylan

Watch my speech below! | | | Wisconsin’s problem is not that we are too divided. It’s that our systems are not built for us. That’s why I have a plan for the State Treasurer’s office to usePublic Power for the Public Good.I will bring Government Transparency into the 21st-Century. I have a degree in economics and a Master's in Public Affairs – but when I got elected to the school board,I found our budgets confusing! As State Treasurer, I will make publicly available information publicly understandable with a visual, public budget dashboard showing exactly how money flows from our State into your community.I will continue to defend Public Education. I have the experience to protect our** $1.6 billion Common School Trust Fund from political interference so it always delivers stable funding for our classrooms.And I’ll work across the state , hand in hand with local organizers, to get basic transparency onto every property tax bill in Wisconsin. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Trump doesn’t understand — or he just doesn’t care
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Hi friend,
There is a deadly Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo right now, and the United States — the country that once led the global response to exactly this kind of crisis — can't do much about it.
Why? Because Donald Trump (with the help of Elon Musk’s DOGE) dismantled every tool we had built to respond exactly to this kind of crisis.
Trump slashed funding to WHO, shut down USAID entirely, and made cuts to the CDC. Oh — and right now, the Trump administration is in the process of reducing the health aid it gives to the DRC and Uganda, the two countries being hit hardest by this Ebola epidemic.
Every single one of these moves has weakened the global health systems that help contain outbreaks like this one, and now, aid workers on the ground have confirmed that our funding cuts have hindered their ability to respond quickly and effectively.
And let's be clear about what else this administration has done to our foreign assistance: they ordered $10 million in contraceptives — already purchased with taxpayer dollars — to be destroyed. They incinerated 500 tons of emergency food, enough to feed 27,000 starving children for a month, even after the U.N. offered to distribute it before it expired.
And now, more people are unnecessarily suffering and dying of Ebola in Africa, because of our government’s dangerous cuts.
You can’t say you care about Americans’ safety, and then gut the very infrastructure that keeps dangerous diseases from reaching our shores in the first place. Ebola doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the consequences of this administration's recklessness.
The bottom line is that foreign assistance isn't charity. It’s about making the world a safer, healthier, more just place, and by containing crises before they become our crises, we protect Americans, too.
Trump doesn't seem to understand that — or maybe he just doesn't care. Either way, the threat of this outbreak is just one more reason we need to flip the House in November.
I’m up for re-election this year, and I could really use your help to make sure we hold my seat, retake the majority in Congress, and fight back against Trump’s reckless cuts that are endangering us all. Will you chip in today to power this work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]

Hi, it's Quentin James, Founder and President of The Collective PAC and author of the forthcoming book "_Our Path Forward: Black Men Redefining American Democracy. "_
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dc83cc5a-53e1-43bc-af96-e5cc7a4a4e46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Today was supposed to be the day.
Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9jb2xsZWN0aXZlcGFjLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MjAyMzczODI2LCJzIjo2ODIwNjM3LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzgxNjYyNzk3LCJleHAiOjIwOTcyMzg3OTcsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.boQS9KY7n42tyZf4lXRWHLWcKWtCzadkO6mRyhuzeW8?)
I picked this date months ago and told you _Our Path Forward_ would be in your hands by now. I announced it in April, on my birthday, with everything mapped out. The book isn't coming today, and I wanted you to hear that from me before you heard it anywhere else.
The hardest part first. In April, I lost my friend Justin Fairfax. Justin, the former lieutenant governor of Virginia, took the life of his wife, Cerina, and then his own. Cerina was a mother, business owner and phenomenal woman. The two children they leave behind will grow up without either of them. I have been grieving her, and grieving him, and trying to make peace with something I may never understand.
Justin is in this book. Over the years, we spent so much time together, talking about ambition and loss and what this country does to Black men who get close to power. We last spoke just two a few weeks before the tragedy took place. Those pages were already written. After April, I couldn't let them stand the way they were. It wouldn't have been honest, and it wouldn't have been right. So I went back in with my editor, section by section, to center the truth as it stands now. That work matters more to me than any date on a calendar.
And the truth is I have not been whole while doing it.
This is Men's Mental Health Month, and I didn't plan for it to land on me the way it has. The grief hasn't come one loss at a time. It stacks up and it doesn't wait its turn. I have been carrying Cerina and Justin. I have been carrying my friend Wesley Brown, who I knew for years, who died of cancer a few weeks ago back home in South Carolina. I have been carrying the memory of two more brothers I lost, Emanuel Perry and Peter Brown, men I still reach for out of habit before I remember they're gone.
All of that, and the work never stopped. The book. The Collective PAC. A new printing franchise. The phone that keeps ringing because the stakes keep climbing. Since April, the Supreme Court gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act in _Louisiana v. Callais_ , the strongest tool we had against racial gerrymandering, and there was no time to grieve before getting back to it. That has been the shape of this season. Leading with everything I've got, while running on a tank closer to empty than I let most people see.
Here is what I keep coming back to. The argument of this book never changed. Black men are solutions, not problems. What these months taught me is something I should have said louder from the beginning. The healing has to come with the power. A man can't carry this much if he's quietly breaking underneath it, and too many of us are breaking in private while the world only sees the title and the suit. That isn't a soft addition to the work. It's the condition for doing the work at all.
So here is where things stand. The manuscript is finished. The book is real, and it's close. We're setting a new date, and I'll share it the moment it's set. The website will catch up to all of this soon. [Pre-orders are open,](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6d210dff-139b-4833-b4bf-15d86a98fad5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and if you've already ordered, thank you for holding the line with me while I get this right.
I built The Collective PAC with my wife, Stefanie, on one belief. Black political power is real, and it's ours to build. More than 500 candidates we've helped send into office are the proof, and the receipts are in the record. This book is the next piece of that. It's coming. I just needed it to be whole before it was on time, the same way I'm learning to be whole myself.
Thank you for being here. I'll talk to you again soon, with a date and with more of this story.
Quentin
* * *
_If you 're carrying something heavy, you don't have to carry it alone. The 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline is free and confidential, available 24/7. Call or text 988._

Hi Peter,

Fourteen years ago, the Obama Administration created DACA and gave hundreds of thousands of young people a chance to live, work, study, and contribute in the only country many of them have ever known. Today, that promise is under attack again.
Across the country, DACA recipients are waiting months for renewals that used to be routine. That means people who follow the rules and do everything asked of them are being left without answers. For many, a delay can mean losing a job or the stability their families depend on.
In San Diego, this is not abstract. Our community has thousands of DACA recipients in our region.
Trump and Republicans in Congress are pouring billions more in funding into ICE and CBP while families in San Diego and across the country live in fear of aggressive enforcement, family separation, and a system with too little accountability.
Scott believes immigration policy should be comprehensive, fair, practical, and humane. That means protecting Dreamers, fixing broken processing systems, and treating people with dignity.
**Add your name to stand with Scott and send a message in fighting for an immigration system that reflects our values.**

---
Immigration should not be used to demonize people who work hard and follow the rules. It should be about fairness, accountability, and a real pathway to the American dream.
It’s crucial we prove Scott and his Democratic colleagues have the support to stand up to Trump and the Republicans pushing their extremist agenda on immigration.
Thank you for your support -
Jasmine, Team Peters

name: Stacy Garrity
subject: Why this race matters
body:
Pennsylvania is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will shape our future.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/K8ZouTCERdS?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd&i=dc10a23dc6)
| | | | | | Peter,

I want to take a moment to talk with you directly about why this race matters so much.
Pennsylvania is the Keystone State. When we're strong, our communities thrive, businesses grow, families succeed, and our children have opportunities right here at home.
Unfortunately, that's not the direction we're headed.
Too many families are struggling to keep up with rising costs. Too many businesses are looking elsewhere to expand. Too many young people are leaving Pennsylvania because they don't see a future here.
We should be leading the nation.
Instead, we've watched our economic competitiveness decline while Harrisburg politicians focus on headlines and political ambitions rather than delivering real results for the people they serve.
I believe Pennsylvania deserves better.
We should be unleashing our energy potential, creating family-sustaining jobs, making our communities safer, improving educational opportunities, and ensuring state government works for taxpayers instead of special interests.
That's what this campaign is about.
This election isn't simply about choosing a Governor.
It's about choosing the direction of our Commonwealth for years to come.
Will we continue down the same path, or will we choose stronger leadership, greater opportunity, and a government that puts Pennsylvania families first?
I know where I stand.
And I'm grateful that you're standing with me.
Thank you for being part of this campaign and helping us build a brighter future for the Commonwealth we love.
---

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1972, police arrested five burglars for breaking into Democratic Party offices at the Watergate, beginning years of investigation that led to the resignation of President Richard Nixon. ([See Photos](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ymzAUBp9GdDD6A-xCRRo6p03JHEuf4CQCeSTZHr99Jqluf7utdnb21229ESc-t590wLWY1xPvmtAayupBFZELAhpxqjhQNsQ7r1rqqZdTr-Y1EKfParvgIqBhOjg1X9R0VVaO3e6MV2EGSWuu0-yjHe3FSE0EY0ZQDB27fzY5qVlJNdlxGBVkGCNGo3y8y6uwEoFbLsPvzGfbEdMnv1AGn48uub21RxXmh9CL0MvBKaF4nA1lyGUTemk7-kdB5YDTf4ReEJ6eGueTUl9Q87N4VKGXNzWUjRq-cn8voD9dceHx5pS4TrOwcjuI0_-A9q1rL6f_BgAA__8kuYO3)) Today, we're reporting on McDonald's bringing [back its fried apple pie](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtu4zAURVdDdTT4l1WwmCnUeZopUgoU36P0AuoDkrGh3QfOFlJf4OKc8_GYHoEy7cu_sKFv6Zh2fNWMrWGZIoaKiQoCtkC54oZlwTTTpIRyXDgu-wkC5WsyHfiEqFB36GV_l26QRthu9VGlQRlrBpgd6FmbNOBdRxeMAVB26Mi_34STvRTSGXuzEgXYhFbLmGYxMCMQqB3l9nnQ3lZM-TqeWG7x2Lrs19bOyvQfpkamxjDHt8F7Y2r8-1Vpx1qZGl9U8H87ysXUuEU49pCh8orlSfvCUyEEHs4zIz8JediwUAyVKyvaymcqbYVwcan1oKSTpisezhflTNX1zIhlC5R_iNqvMj69-g4AAP__8oGHXA) for the first time since 1992. ## Iran Ceasefire Details Start to Emerge
New details of the [U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAMQE8TuoycEMJMkWIbutl2S-QhDngVCErCoNnTr_j6N_jNa2w9-fnPc3wiR97m37iSqyGNG50lUq2Ux4mwUOBMnipyLLRSnim8eNSgrQQrVT965PgZTeNdINLUNuRUf1f2oQx0zeLs_f6woA0GnMDoqQ0T9pMO0NnOG-gbdpcNrOoVKGu6W6cIfBeoa9UUXvAQBshzTfn2N_FWFwrxk96Ub1Nam-iWWvci2l9CD0IP22dPpV4joYdLLPQAF9SFo8irT-jhO0mmII8iOeMmPWGUmd6EkbysvFLkjWRI-Vo5uS4-44lRtgAvGY7NyyXl9fgndywFZxJ6aLLz-8kxcrG9MDCvyPHr0Pqj776d_h8AAP__tiCOCA) are surfacing ahead of Friday's signing in Geneva, including a ceasefire extending to Lebanon, a 30-day timeline to lift the naval blockade, the Strait of Hormuz reopening under Iranian arrangements, and temporary oil sanctions waivers. Also reportedly included in the agreement is a controversial [Gulf-funded $300 billion reconstruction fund](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbvOnDAQhZ8GulnZg7lsQZFmuz9tSjTg8TKRwcgeFv15-oi8Qtqjc9Gn8-tr-iKJsr9_0sajhjTtfJXIqpynhalwkMyelSQW3ji_OcwyocEOTAe2nzxJ_J5c7cfAjNzUPNp-sN3TOtPW6xgcPmfzROudtw0OZNAh-mHom4abQLWMd5vpbG-N7Vz7aC0b3wZuG7uE2TwrZ9iLpvz4nWTXlUP8Th_OjyVtdRxX1aNUzY8KXxW-rut6qGxc9nTdKLfpllOOvsLXJt5HBqaiFb7OApJph4NpYfBMESzCca_Alk7I_GGK7KFoJlFIAdaUt_MPHJF2aIyBWWKUtEM4dw9nAc0pHXCJrj7TRREoqyyRwbaucwMOWOfRH9cdK11fOfPeSOI_Fv2vAz4j_g0AAP__xbacKA). The fund, which is described as a private investment vehicle, not U.S. taxpayer money, has drawn sharp criticism from some GOP legislators who say it mirrors the Obama-era deal Trump once condemned. Vice President JD Vance said the full text had been deliberately withheld for diplomatic sequencing but would be [released this week](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOqzAYhJ8GOiPfMFC4OA1dTrsl-gNj8kfmIuOEzduv2FfYcjTSjL7v6zbciCOv839a4HPYhhXnEZEz0jCCDgROmJCJ44EFaUa486CldkI6oZphIo6fwZaTD4CGKeFV0yrXKSvr8uFdq-6tNpZadKrTGoZsS6Z2JthJGirZX2vSqUZJ5Wxd1QpyqgNqo8Zwl11hJSbOW6qeG6_5gRA_2xupGreljP6R834U5l-h-0L353lWYfu-KK6-0H3kN8SVC92_DsGJVrGDRgiaE7BgzSKn17ILPhIhiudrhVB1mfy0nxwjH64prJwX4vj7mf8k6u31TwAAAP__YEJ9Tw). Iran would reaffirm its pledge never to build a nuclear weapon and enter 60 days of talks on its nuclear program. One unsettled issue is Israel's position. The country says it's not bound by the Lebanon ceasefire provision, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisting Israeli forces will remain there "as long as necessary."

body:
A tropical system off the Texas coast could strengthen into [Tropical Storm Arthur](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAYhJ_G7rAAY-MUFNe4y7VXWr_ht40OQwT_hmSffpVIq32A7UYz0uib-XddruCDj_tfONHQY0tLxFoCEmFeKKebtxAKpXxWIHsEqCf8x0VyOTI-MqEXBz48F9U6s3J3ES0aoScxXpRUvD3MoLlQfHQ4CqdXvtqeOxCTHdYBp8FOrTevMj4KLQTvh6lzl5VrVLjCNsA0bY3i6Dyl3NGBhA8oW3imO-bOprMN5iC6lab_08i5kXOttYurdVt9xS8DgQ7MP4rZFCNa8ik2cgb2vZKVZyE8mS9sRyIfd5byDtF_omMRITM6kL0B2P4RNmYTFGrkrHivBRdtNu5WfQi-jLpRfD_Bhzcj_e7Zu5FfAQAA__9NgpCf) on Wednesday, the first named storm of the 2026 Atlantic season, forecasters say.

Greg Abbott issued a for Monday after storms that began over the weekend unleashed flash flooding, hazardous winds, and tornado threats across much of the state. The order unlocks the full range of state emergency resources, with additional counties possible. Abbott directed the Texas Division of Emergency Management to run 24-hour operations at the State Emergency Operations Center, and Houston Mayor John Whitmire ordered citywide flood preparations. Crews pulled drivers from submerged vehicles across the Hill Country and San Antonio, where floodwaters swallowed highways and forced water rescues. Texas Game Wardens reported multiple swiftwater rescues. At least . A Bandera County woman whose car was swept into a creek early Monday. She called 911, saying she was floating downstream and couldn't escape. The call dropped, and crews found her submerged vehicle hours later. Gulf Storm May Become Arthur A tropical system off the Texas coast could strengthen into on Wednesday, the first named storm of the 2026 Atlantic season, forecasters say. The National Hurricane Center designated it on Tuesday, giving it a 70% chance of formation within 48 hours. A Tropical Storm Watch runs from Sargent, Texas, to Morgan City, Louisiana, with the system tracking offshore on Wednesday before moving inland by Thursday. The bigger danger is rain. Forecasters warn of life-threatening flash flooding from Texas into the Florida Panhandle, with widespread and isolated totals near a foot. Coastal gusts could top 40 mph, with rip currents, minor surge, and isolated tornadoes possible. Officials urge residents to avoid flooded roads. body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)

Peter,
Last night, Mike Collins won the GOP runoff to face me this November. **The general election is underway, and I can’t win here in Georgia without you.**
I’ll explain what comes next in a moment, but if you already understand how important this Senate race in Georgia is — _and are ready to make today one of the biggest and best days of my entire campaign..._ use the link below to chip in $5.
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-em-jun26**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=2&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)
Peter, here’s what’s next.
__I expect my race in Georgia to be the biggest and most expensive Senate race in the country.__
**Trump and MAGA want me defeated and gone.** It’s their TOP priority, and they’re going to spend the next five months — and hundreds of millions of dollars — trying to get it done.
What that means is that we’ll be facing lots of Super PAC money and Trump visits between now and November. We’ll be up against wild attacks from conspiracy theorists and all sorts of misinformation and lies online.
It’s going to take an _even bigger_ effort to win in 2026 than it took in 2021. And that work has to start right now.
[**Peter, rush $5 to my campaign today and make sure we have the resources to run full speed, right out of the gate >>>**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=3&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)
**$5** because Mike Collins will have the full support (and BIG $$$) of Trump’s MAGA machine, including dark-money Super PACs with limitless sums of money to pour into this race.
**$5** because we need to build out a MASSIVE organizing and mobilization effort that will reach every Georgian, all across the state.
**$5** because the general election has already started, and in order to accomplish our goals, we can’t afford to be behind for even a single second.
[**Please, Peter: Use this link to make a $5 contribution to my reelection campaign. Do it TODAY and help my team and me start strong!**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=4&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_
| | **[DONATE $5](https://act.electjon.com/go/34?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.9pSZbG&amount=5&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=5&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)**
---
****
| **[DONATE OTHER](https://act.electjon.com/go/34?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.9pSZbG&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=6&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)**
---
****
The fight is on. And I can’t say enough how grateful I am to have you in my corner.
Together, we will win Georgia and save our Republic.
Gratefully,
Sen. Jon Ossoff
_P.S. I wanted to talk to you about my opponent and our plan for the race, but there’s one more thing I have to mention. At the end of this month, I’ve got an official FEC fundraising deadline. The first one of the general election and a major signal to Trump, MAGA, and outside Super PACs as they decide where to spend their $$$._
_A BIG number that shows BIG enthusiasm would do a lot to scare off the Super PAC money. But if we fall short... they’ll take that as a sign of weakness, and we’ll be swamped with attack ads._
[**_Please, chip in $5 today!_**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=7&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260617-1-subs&t=8&akid=2399%2E5691347%2EfzCJaC)**
